messages:
Lina: Kickoff for ACME POC. Need alignment on acceptance criteria, cost targets, security Qs and timeline. Can we scope the golden prompts & scoring today?
Jordan: Main deliverable: invoice extraction + short-answer QA. We'll evaluate extraction F1 and answer correctness. Target: extraction F1 >= 0.90, QA exact-match >= 0.78.
Priya: Cost constraint from procurement: token spend cap of $1500/month during trial. Can we estimate per-1k-token cost under Dedicated? If not, list recommendations to meet cap.
Eli: Recommended stack: quantized LLM + lightweight reranker (embedding-based) for QA. That should cut tokens for candidate generation. Expect p95 latency ~650ms with small batching.
Lina: Security asks include: data residency confirmation, KMS integration, and retention window. Priya, compile the answers for the questionnaire; legal needs them by Thu.
Priya: On it. Also flagging IP/data usage clause in SOW — ACME wants explicit delete-on-demand.
Jordan: For scoring/harness, proposal:

- golden_set: 200 labeled invoices (mix of scanned OCR noise + clean)
- adversarial_bucket: 25 tricky samples (merged lines, ambiguous dates)
- scoring: weighted F1 (0.7) + answer correctness (0.2) + cost penalty (0.1)
- pass_threshold: 0.87 overall

Add human evaluation: 15 samples for edge cases.
Lina: That weight config is fine. FinanceOps: if we hit that token cap, can we simulate costs for 2x and 4x burst?
FinanceOps: Yes. Need: expected tokens per request, qps profile. If burst 4x, pricing tier changes — I'll draft 3 scenarios (baseline, burst, committed).
Eli: Harness details: runner will do 5 runs per prompt across model variants, compute mean/median, and record token usage. Also include a prefix-cache test: repeat prefixes to measure cache hit speed and cost reduction.
Jordan: Important: regression gating: nightly smoke on golden set. If extraction F1 drops >4% vs baseline OR cost per 1k tokens increases >15%, block any rollout.
Priya: Timeline check: security Q answers Thu, harness + seed goldens Wed EOD, first baseline run Thu morning, customer review Fri afternoon. Is that feasible?
Eli: Engineering can deliver harness + export to s3 in ~30h. I'll tag artifacts: s3://redwood-acme/poc/harness-v1/results.jsonl
Lina: Great. Action items: Eli - harness + prefix cache test (36h). Jordan - assemble golden set + adversarial seed (today). Priya - security questionnaire answers (Thu). FinanceOps - three pricing scenarios (EOD).
SalesBot: Reminder: add canary rollback plan to SOW. Suggested: 5% initial traffic, 24h monitor, auto-fail on F1 < 0.86 or p95 latency > 850ms.
Jordan: Also adding sample prompt template in harness: "Parse invoice text and return fields invoice_id, date, total, currency, line_items as JSON. Return empty array for line_items if none."
Priya: One more thing: ACME wants a demo of the human-eval flow. Jordan, can you prepare a short sandbox UI with 15 edge samples?
Jordan: Yep, will push a UI export and CSV to S3: s3://redwood-acme/poc/human-eval/edge_samples.csv
Lina: Thanks. We'll sync Thurs 4pm to review harness outputs and security answers. If blockers pop up, post here and I'll escalate. :white_check_mark:
